chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam narrated from Ziyād ibn Abī al-Ḥallāl, who said:
I asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم: did he make a bequest to al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام along with Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام?
I said: "While they were at that age?"
He said: "Yes, and this would not be for anyone other than those two at less than five years."

key_terms.أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: the Commander of the Faithful, referring to ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.أَوْصَى: made a bequest or designated in his will
key_terms.الْحَسَنِ: al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, named here as one of those included in the bequest
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: al-Ḥusayn عليه السلام, named here as one of those included in the bequest
key_terms.خَمْسِ سِنِينَ: five years, indicating the age threshold mentioned in the report

ai.seo_question: Did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم appoint al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام in his bequest even when they were very young?
ai.summary: This hadith affirms that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم included al-Ḥasan and al-Ḥusayn عليهما السلام in the bequest together with Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام despite their young age. It indicates a special and exclusive status for them that does not apply to others under five years of age.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5566 - Ali ibn Al-Hakam narrated from Ziyad ibn Abi Al-Hallal, who said:

I asked Abu Abdullah (as), whether the Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, had appointed Al-Hasan (as) and Al-Hussain (as), peace be upon them both, along with the Commander of the Faithful (as), peace be upon him, in his will.
I asked: "Even though they were at that young age?"
Imam (as) said: "Yes, and this would not be for anyone else under the age of five."
